newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 176 mln of 2-yr, 5-yr fixed bonds.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 176 mln of 2-yr, 5-yr fixed bonds.

text.p: Poland sold 164 million zlotys of 16-percent two-year bonds and 12 million zlotys of 12-percent five-year bonds against the treasury's joint 800 million zloty offer, the finance ministry said.
Investors bid for 277 million zlotys of the shorter paper and 17 million of the longer bonds.
The minimum accepted price of two-year bonds was 0.04 point up to 93.16 from the last auction on November 21, while the average accepted price was 0.02 point up to 93.26.
The minimum accepted price of five-year bonds was 0.04 point down to 80.50, while the average accepted price was 0.26 point down to 80.55.
